maria: heads-up — onboarding cosmos-13b-int4 with long-context suite, hitting divergence around token ~12k on repeated-header docs

sanjay: which quant profile + environment?

maria: int4-v2-sparse on dedicated-dev pool. repro command below:
```
python run_eval.py --model cosmos-13b-int4 --prompt-file tests/longdoc/repeat_header.txt --kv-debug --seed 42 --max-tokens 65000
```

ciaran: any logs showing KV index / rope offsets?

maria: pasted the tail of the server log, looks like an index mismatch when wrapping:
```
[2025-11-03 15:20:11] KV_SYNC shard=0 idx=32766 expected_idx=32767 actual_idx=32765
[2025-11-03 15:20:11] ROPE_ROTATE phase=16383 -> computed_phase=16382
[2025-11-03 15:20:11] WARNING: prefetched token mismatch: token_id=19834
```

elaine: @maria can you try running with ROPE_MODE=legacy to A/B quickly?

maria: ran legacy mode — prefix alignment improved, no immediate divergence, but latency is up. quick numbers: per-token latency 3.1ms -> 3.6ms, ppl 18.2 -> 17.8 (small sample)

sanjay: maybe packing/layout changed for int4-v2-sparse, causing rotation math to index wrong stride when seq > 32k. try `--kv-offset-fix=1` to see if shifting index helps

maria: tried --kv-offset-fix=1, reduces frequency of mismatch but we still see ghost tokens after repeated prepends. minimal repro script:
```
# short repro: prepend header 4000x then generate 1k tokens
for i in range(4000):
    ctx.prepend(header)
out = model.generate(ctx, max_new_tokens=1000)
assert not contains_ghosts(out)
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: quant-int4-v2 rollout -> pool dev-4 (id:dev-4) at 2025-11-03T15:22:03Z

ciaran: hypothesis: kernel change in roperot->roperot2 altered how rotation phase is computed for packed int4 lanes. when stride wrap crosses 32768 boundary we get half-step phase reads. I'll bisect the kernel commits. assigning to myself to run low-latency bisect, will post commit id when found

maria: thanks — I'm collecting failure seeds and will push eval harness artifacts (CSV of seeds + traces) to s3://redwood-evals/cosmos13b/int4-longprefill/ and tag @eng-runtime

sanjay: :thumbsup: keep the quick triage notes here so we can correlate with Dedicated perf dashboards
